NFTT literary family: verified detector artifact, not real debt. The detector composites translucent backgrounds (e.g. .vector's linear-gradient(rgba(255,77,109,.05),var(--bg))) and transparent elements over WHITE instead of the actual #020408 page, producing phantom light bgs (#fff6f8 = that rgba over white exactly) and false low-contrast reports. Real rendered contrast is 14-17:1 on the near-black page; audited 2026-09-26, see _PATTERNS/kintsugi-visual-grammar-seams.md. The genuine --dim 4.0:1 issue was separately fixed to AA (#748699).
